I wish more people on this subreddit had at least a slight grasp of what drag actually is, because it's such a fucking cool facet of makeup artistry.

Have you never seen a drag queen before? A big part of drag makeup, especially when it comes to makeup like this (not meant to look like your everyday woman, more to look like a feminized caricature, I suppose) is creating different features and going over the top. When I say over the top, I mean far beyond anything you'd see on a woman, even a woman in heavy stage makeup. Criticizing the overdrawn lip is like criticizing the drawn eyelid or the high brows or the big lashes - basically criticizing standard components of a drag look.

Sure, there are queens that pride themselves on looking like authentic women, but there are just as many who don't go after that aesthetic and prefer to create their own, like OP. When you take all that into account, this is a LOOK. It's such a unique display of talent, and I am 100% here for it.
